description: Google Ads — daily account, campaign, ad group, keyword, search term, conversion and geo performance, plus call-level detail

ads_campaign_daily.description: Campaign performance per day, incl. phone calls and impression share

ads_conversion_daily.description: Conversions by campaign and conversion action per day

ads_calls.description: One row per call through a Google forwarding number

calls_by_campaign_last_30_days.description: Calls from ads and call conversions per campaign, last 30 days
calls_by_campaign_last_30_days.sql: SELECT c.campaign_name, SUM(c.phone_calls) AS calls_from_ads, SUM(c.cost) AS cost, SUM(c.conversions) AS conversions FROM ads_campaign_daily c WHERE c.date >= date('now','-30 days') GROUP BY c.campaign_name ORDER BY calls_from_ads DESC

call_conversions_by_type.description: Call conversions split by how the call happened
call_conversions_by_type.sql: SELECT a.type, a.name, SUM(d.conversions) AS conversions FROM ads_conversion_daily d JOIN ads_conversion_actions a ON a.customer_id = d.customer_id AND a.conversion_action = d.conversion_action WHERE a.type IN ('AD_CALL','WEBSITE_CALL','CLICK_TO_CALL') GROUP BY a.type, a.name
